errors.fix: Declare the variable before use, or check for a typo in its name

errors.message: A required module could not be found
errors.fix: Run 'pip install <module>' to install the missing dependency, or check the import path

errors.message: A module or name could not be imported
errors.fix: Check that the module is installed and the imported name actually exists in it
Check the file for mismatched tabs/spaces or a missing indent after a colon
Check the file near the reported location for invalid Python syntax

errors.message: An operation was applied to a value of the wrong type
errors.fix: Check the types of the values involved and convert or fix them as needed

errors.message: Attempted to access an attribute that doesn't exist on the object
errors.fix: Check the object's type and available attributes/methods, or check for a typo

errors.message: Attempted to access a list/sequence index that is out of range
errors.fix: Check the length of the sequence before indexing into it

errors.message: Attempted to access a dictionary key that doesn't exist
errors.fix: Check the key exists first, or use dict.get() with a default value
Check the divisor isn't zero before performing the division

errors.message: A value of the right type but inappropriate content was passed to a function
errors.fix: Check the value being passed matches what the function expects

errors.message: Stack overflow, usually from unbounded recursion
errors.fix: Check for a recursive function that's missing (or never reaches) its base case

errors.message: Attempted to open a file that doesn't exist
errors.fix: Check the file path for typos, and that it's relative to the right working directory

errors.message: Insufficient permissions to perform the operation
errors.fix: Check the file/directory permissions, or run with the necessary privileges

errors.message: A local variable was referenced before assignment
errors.fix: Assign the variable before using it, or add a 'global'/'nonlocal' declaration if it's meant to refer to an outer scope

errors.message: Used an operator between two incompatible types
errors.fix: Convert one side to match the other's type before applying the operator

errors.message: pip isn't available for this Python installation
